description: Figure 5 is a grouped bar chart displaying the proportion of incorrectly answered samples, measured as a percentage on the vertical axis labeled “Ratio (%)”, where the co-occurrence frequency of model-generated entities with the question entity (RPop_Ge) is less than that of the ground-truth entity (RPop_GT). The horizontal axis categorizes the data by domain: “Movies”, “Songs”, and “Basketball”. For each domain, three bars are grouped together, each representing a different large language model: Llama3 (blue), Qwen2 (red), and ChatGPT (yellow). The chart shows that for “Movies” and “Songs”, all three models have a high proportion of such incorrect samples, with Llama3 and Qwen2 showing values near 90% and ChatGPT around 70%. For “Basketball”, the proportions are significantly lower, with Llama3 at approximately 65%, Qwen2 at about 55%, and ChatGPT around 60%. The bars are not sorted, and no visual emphasis is applied to any specific bar.
